  • Method Details

    • getStartCardIndex

      public static int getStartCardIndex(CardType type)
      Returns the index of the first card of the parameter type. Indexes start from 1 and are sequential for all the game card: first resource cards, then gold ones, starters and finally objectives.
      Parameters:
      type - the card type.
      Returns:
      the id of the first card of the specified type.
      See Also:
      • CardType
